title: A double click on Delete Credit Term deletes once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. Double-click the red "Delete Credit Term" button quickly.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The button turns disabled while deleting.
  • One toast "term A deleted" shows and no error alert (such as "Credit term not found.") appears.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R11: “The confirm button in the Make Default and Delete confirmations is disabled while the change is saving, so a double click saves once.”
